subject: Exec briefing: OKR ramp plan + QBR operations playbook
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Emma Parker <emma.parker@acme.com>
Cc: Jake Lin <jake.lin@strategyworks.com>
Date: 2026-12-05T08:12:00-08:00
Subject: Exec briefing: OKR ramp plan + QBR operations playbook

Team — attaching the first draft of the Q4 OKR ramp and an operational playbook for the QBR cadence. I want to lock owners and success criteria by end of day Monday so the GTM and product teams can finalize their decks.

Key asks:
- Please review the OKR draft worksheet (tab "Owners + Metrics") and call out any metric/owner mismatches.
- Confirm any external invitees we should include for the QBR (I've included Emma and Jake as outside stakeholders for context).
- If you need a mod to the playbook (escalation flow or reporting window), highlight it inline in the Confluence link.

Attachments: Q4_OKR_Ramp_DRAFT.xlsx; QBR_Operations_Playbook_v1.4.pdf
Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=Q4_OKR_Ramp_v2
Confluence: confluence.redwood.com/display/OPS/QBR+Playbook+v1.4

Thanks — I want to run this in the leadership readout on Wednesday so please prioritize.

Naomi Feldman
Head of Strategy Operations
Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Emma Parker <emma.parker@acme.com>
Date: 2026-12-05T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Exec briefing: OKR ramp plan + QBR operations playbook

Thanks Naomi — quick read-through notes below. I’ve left inline comments in the sheet as well (tab "Metrics Rationale").

1) Latency & Cost OKR: propose separating into two leading indicators — median p99 latency for interactive routes (target 120ms) and cost per 1M tokens by workload (target -12% WoW). Right now they’re combined and will make tradeoffs messy for infra/product.

2) Reliability owner: move from "Platform SRE" to "Serving Runtime" (assigned to Engineering) — they can commit to runbook SLAs.

3) QBR cadence: suggest adding a weekly pre-read one-pager 48 hours ahead for the execs; the playbook currently has only a 24-hour window. That 48-hour buffer reduces fire drills.

I can take the lead on the ops runbook tweaks if folks are OK with me owning the "escalation -> fallback model mapping" section.

Vivek
VP, Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-05T12:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Exec briefing: OKR ramp plan + QBR operations playbook

Appreciate the draft. A few product-focused calibration notes: 

- Growth metric: "DAU using Redwood embeddings" is useful but noisy. Can we make the primary KR "Embedding usage across top-5 customers" with a supporting funnel metric? That will help tie to revenue conversations in QBR.
- Owner clarity: on the sheet, Product lists two owners for "model onboarding speed" — can we pick a single owner (recommend: Marissa) and a backup?
- Timing: if leadership signoff is Wednesday, product needs final by Friday to bake into the enablement deck. If anyone expects delays, flag immediately.

I’ll update the product KRs and push an edit to the shared drive by EOD.

—Karthik
Director, Product Management

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Emma Parker <emma.parker@acme.com>
Date: 2026-12-05T15:26:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Exec briefing: OKR ramp plan + QBR operations playbook

Thanks — I updated the product-owner rows and added a brief customer-impact note for the top 3 KRs. Emma and Jake: adding you to ensure our customer-facing metrics reflect what matters to you for the QBR. Would love any quick thumbs on the "top-5 customer usage" framing.

I've also attached a short slide (QBR_Deck_Snippet_MKTG.pdf) that pulls the customer narratives we plan to surface. If leadership signs off Wednesday, marketing will finalize the external-facing story and roster the case studies.

Attachments: QBR_Deck_Snippet_MKTG.pdf; mutual_action_plan_template.docx

Marissa Cole
VP, Product Marketing
Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Emma Parker <emma.parker@acme.com>, Jake Lin <jake.lin@strategyworks.com>
Date: 2026-12-06T10:43:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Exec briefing: OKR ramp plan + QBR operations playbook — final call for sign-off

Great thread — thanks for the quick turns. Summary and next steps: 

- Vivek to own ops runbook updates (escalation -> fallback mapping) — deliverable: updated Confluence page by Monday 12/07 COB.
- Marissa is owner for "model onboarding speed" KR; Karthik is backup and will update the product tab accordingly (thanks).
- Metric changes: split latency/cost into two leading indicators (Vivek will reflect in the sheet).
- Marketing: finalize external slides and case studies if leadership sign-off occurs Wednesday.

Please reply-all with either "SIGNOFF" or "HOLD: <reason>" before 3pm PT today. If no HOLDs by that time I will mark this as approved and circulate the leadership readout slide pack.

Naomi Feldman
Head of Strategy Operations
Redwood Inference
